summary: 12 selected items, within the 7-12 target. Coverage is well-distributed across OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta MSL, xAI, Google, and open-source, with no single author overrepresented. The GPT-5.6 launch is covered from two distinct angles (OpenAI's official Thursday announcement and Theo's hands-on practitioner review), which is complementary rather than redundant. The two Anthropic items are separate stories (Fable 5 access extension vs. Claude for Open Source) from different accounts. Reported/secondhand claims (ns123abc Grok 4.5 'per a staff memo', RodmanAi Tencent OSS) carry named sources with concrete claims and are acceptable as reported news, with sourcing noted. The reserve item from sama duplicates the selected OpenAI launch tweet but is not selected, so it does not affect the set. Zephyr_hg's Hassabis clip is very thin on engagement (588 views) but is recent and from a named lab CEO. All selected items are kept; no replacements needed.
